sections.label: Cybersecurity professionals and training numbers
sections.summary: Singapore's cybersecurity professionals more than doubled to almost 6,000 in 2019 versus 2014, and almost 5,000 Singaporeans have had cybersecurity training since 2016.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: Based on the Infocomm Media Development Authority's survey, the number of cybersecurity professionals in Singapore in 2019 more than doubled to almost 6,000 compared to 2014.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: Since 2016, almost 5,000 Singaporeans have undergone cybersecurity training as part of the Tech Skills Accelerator programme.

sections.label: CSA places and youth women programmes
sections.summary: CSA has earmarked 120 places over two years for Government cybersecurity roles, and SG Cyber Youth and SG Cyber Women have engaged over 7,000 participants.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: CSA has earmarked 120 places over the next two years for cybersecurity roles in Government agencies.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: The SG Cyber Youth and SG Cyber Women programmes have engaged over 7,000 participants to date, to encourage them to pursue a career in cybersecurity.

sections.label: Public sector cybersecurity jobs competition
sections.summary: Public sector cybersecurity jobs are attractive to local graduates with high awareness and significant competition, but globally there is a dearth of talent and competition for skillsets.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: To answer the question Mr Pritam Singh is asking, this set of cybersecurity jobs, especially those within the public sector and agencies, such as the Home Team, DSTA, Cyber Security Agency, GovTech and various others, are attractive to our local cybersecurity graduates.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The competition to get into these jobs is significant and the awareness of the opportunities afforded by these jobs amongst our local graduates is very high.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Nevertheless, globally, there is a dearth of talent for these types of jobs and there is a global competition for the kind of skillsets that we need to deploy in cybersecurity.
